questions.question_text: [PIPELINE TEST — safe to delete] If 4x - 3 = 13, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Add 3 to both sides: 4x = 16. Divide by 4: x = 4.
questions.distractor_a_explanation: Results from dividing 13 by 4 without adding 3 first, then rounding down.
questions.distractor_d_explanation: Results from adding instead of dividing after isolating 4x.
